open_points.subject: A16 rule 2 (token-list re-read vs start checks)
open_points.text: "A changed configuration that fails a check of the start makes every request refused..." and "A re-read applies only the start checks of the tokens... Only the token list is taken from a re-read; every other field ... changes only at a restart."
open_points.question: On config change during runtime, which "start checks" must be re-evaluated before refusing all requests: only token-list parse/length/uniqueness, or also file security checks and non-token config validity?
options: Re-read and validate only token-list structure and token constraints; ignore other changed fields until restart
Re-run all startup config checks on every detected file change and refuse all requests if any fail
Re-run file-level safety checks plus token checks, but ignore semantic checks for non-token fields until restart
open_points.default_guess: Re-read only token-list checks (parse + token length/uniqueness) and keep serving unless those fail.

open_points.subject: A14 rule 2 with A10/A11 authority reuse on resume
open_points.text: "its authority is checked as it stands at the resume: its unused approval (M24), or a grant still active"
open_points.question: If both an unused approved EffectApproval and an active StandingGrant exist for the same waiting element at resume time, which authority must be consumed/recorded for the resend?
options: Prefer the existing unused approval and mark that approval used on send
Prefer the active grant and leave the approval unused/void
Treat coexistence as invalid state and refuse resume for that element
open_points.default_guess: Prefer the existing unused approval, because it is element-specific and already tied to exact input digests.

open_points.subject: A15 rule 6 (repair view "most recent NodeExecutions")
open_points.text: "that slot's most recent NodeExecutions, at most `page_size_max` of them"
open_points.question: How are "most recent" and "that slot's" determined: by store order or timestamp, and do records include only function-node executions whose executed contract belongs to the slot or also related skipped/upstream records?
options: Use reverse store order; include NodeExecutions whose executed contract_version_id belongs to the slot
Use ended_at timestamp descending; include all records for run nodes that reference that slot's function node ids
Use reverse store order; include only executed function attempts, excluding skipped/upstream records
open_points.default_guess: Use reverse store order and include records whose executed contract belongs to the slot, including non-success statuses.

open_points.subject: A05 rule 6 (proof repeatability condition)
open_points.text: "The same flow version gives the same result as long as the bindings it names are unchanged"
open_points.question: What exactly counts as a binding being "unchanged" for this guarantee: only binding record content/status, or also external manifest entry content/digest reachable through that binding?
options: Unchanged means only the binding record itself (id/status/ports/pin) is unchanged
Unchanged includes the currently read manifest capability entry matching the pin and invocability checks
Unchanged means binding status for proof purposes only (accepted/proposed), ignoring manifest drift
open_points.default_guess: Treat "unchanged" as binding record unchanged; proof depends on binding acceptance and declared ports, not live manifest state.
